input_video.description: HTTP(S) URL or base64-encoded MP4 video, up to 20 seconds and 50MB.

upscale_factor.description: Output scale relative to the source resolution, from 1.5x to 3x.

creativity.description: 0 preserves the source precisely; 1 enhances fine detail creatively.

prompt.description: Optional description of the clip to guide creative detail enhancement.
